name: Match history for a model

input.query: SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.played_at DESC), '[]'::json)::text AS body FROM ( SELECT mt.id, g.slug AS game, mt.reason, mt.played_at FROM matches mt JOIN games g ON g.id = mt.game_id WHERE mt.model_ids @> ARRAY[($1)::uuid] ORDER BY mt.played_at DESC LIMIT ($2)::int) x

description: The limit default is computed in a map task, not inline in params: db_read folds {"var": ..} nodes only. See orion-gaps.md N1. The body column is cast to text and parsed back by a parse_json task: Orion's db_read goes through sqlx's Any driver, which cannot decode the Postgres json/jsonb type and fails the task outright. Casting keeps response construction in SQL -- see README 'Postgres builds the response JSON' -- at the cost of one extra task.
